title: carex vulpinoidea var. xanthocarpa
intro: Carex vulpinoidea var. xanthocarpa, commonly known as golden-fruited fox sedge, is a type of sedge plant belonging to the family Cyperaceae. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its various health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of golden-fruited fox sedge include wound healing, anti-arthritic effects, and potential antiviral activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
